title: The integral exceptional adjoint on constructible complexes
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put $A_n=R/(\varpi^n)$ for $n\geq1$. On each small pro-etale site $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ use modules over the completed sheaf $R_W=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the derived-complete constructible category $D^b_c(W,R)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and the uniform finite-reduction Tor condition [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Write $L_n=L\otimes^L_{R_Y}(A_n)_Y$ for derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] and $\operatorname{Res}_n$ for restriction from $(A_n)_W$ to $R_W$ [def-weil-integral-derived-restriction-of-scalars]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the finite constructible exceptional functors $Rf_n^!$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] and integral compact supports [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Define

$$
G_fL=R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_n^!L_n
\qquad(L\in D^b_c(Y,R)).
$$

The transitions are adjoint to the coefficient-normalization comparisons of [lem-coef-finite-exceptional], with the quotient cocycle of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Specify their functorial coherent realization to be $\mathcal E_f\mathcal R_YL$ of [lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization], using the strict coefficient-system reduction/limit adjunction of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. This fixes the lift and its maps before applying the total derived inverse limit. Here $R\varprojlim$ is the total derived inverse-limit functor on coherent towers, with its natural Roos triangle [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Then $G_f$ maps $D^b_c(Y,R)$ to $D^b_c(X,R)$, is right adjoint to integral $Rf_!$ on these categories, and has canonical identifications

$$
G_fL\cong D_{X,R}f^*_{\mathrm{comp}}D_{Y,R}L,
\qquad (G_fL)\otimes^L_{R_X}(A_n)_X\cong Rf_n^!L_n.
$$

Here $f^*_{\mathrm{comp}}M=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_nf_n^*M_n$ is the integral completed pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], and $D_{W,R}M=R\mathcal Hom_{R_W}(M,\omega_{W,R})$ is derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] into the dualizing object of [prop-coef-integral-dualizing]. If the reductions of $L$ have Tor interval $[a,b]$, $a\leq b$, and $d_X,d_Y$ are nonnegative integer dimension bounds for $X,Y$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], one output interval is $[a-2d_X,b+2d_Y]$. For nonempty schemes one may take $d_X=\dim X$ and $d_Y=\dim Y$; for an empty scheme use the bound $0$. The comparisons identify the canonical units and counits with the finite ones after reduction. In particular, for the structure morphism $a_X:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, the dualizing object of [prop-coef-integral-dualizing] is $G_{a_X}R$. This is an adjunction on the stated constructible categories.

proof.text: Put $H=D_{X,R}f^*_{\mathrm{comp}}D_{Y,R}L$ and $E=\mathcal E_f\mathcal R_YL$. The dual-system lemma gives constructible $H$, its stated Tor interval, and $b_L:\mathcal R_XH\cong E$. Since $H$ is derived complete, the actual-reconstruction lemma makes the actual unit $u_H:H\to\mathcal L_X\mathcal R_XH$ invertible. Thus $\alpha_L=\mathcal L_X(b_L)u_H:H\cong G_fL$ is natural and transfers constructibility and the interval. Effectivity gives $c_L=e_E:\mathcal R_XG_fL\cong E$. Counit naturality and the triangle identity give $c_L\mathcal R_X(\alpha_L)=b_Le_{\mathcal R_XH}\mathcal R_Xu_H=b_L$, so these are the specified finite dual-formula reductions.

source.place: Paragraph 1: apply coherent dual comparison and natural reconstruction

proof.text: For $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ write $F_f=Rf_!$. The mapping-system lemma gives constructible $F_fK$, its canonical $c_K:\mathcal R_YF_fK\cong\mathcal F_f\mathcal R_XK$, and $\Psi_{K,L}$. Compose $\lambda_{K,G_fL}^{-1}\circ R\lim(\Psi_{K,L})\circ\lambda_{F_fK,L}$. This is a natural isomorphism of global mapping complexes; on $H^0$ it gives $\Phi_{K,L}:\operatorname{Hom}_Y(F_fK,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_X(K,G_fL)$.

source.place: Paragraph 2: assemble the three mapping-complex isomorphisms

proof.text: Define $\eta_K=\Phi_{K,F_fK}(1)$ and $\epsilon_L=\Phi^{-1}_{G_fL,L}(1)$. Naturality gives $\Phi(u)=G_f(u)\eta_K$ and $\Phi^{-1}(v)=\epsilon_LF_f(v)$. The inverse identities on identity maps yield $\epsilon_{F_fK}F_f(\eta_K)=1$ and $G_f(\epsilon_L)\eta_{G_fL}=1$. Hence these specified maps define $F_f\dashv G_f$.

source.place: Paragraph 2: units, counits and triangle identities

proof.text:
The projection formula for $\lambda$ sends an actual $u:F_fK\to L$ to $u_n$. The evaluated formula for $\Psi$ consequently gives
$$c_{L,n}(\Phi_{K,L}(u))_n=\operatorname{adj}_n(u_n c_{K,n}^{-1}).$$
Taking $L=F_fK,u=1$ identifies the reduced unit with the finite unit under $c_K$. Applying the inverse formula at $K=G_fL,v=1$ identifies the reduced counit with the finite counit under $c_L$ and the compact-support comparison on $G_fL$. These are the normalized finite maps; equality of integral maps is not inferred from their reductions.

For $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, the unit coefficient complex $R_s$ has its flat-term model $R_s$ itself, so $\mathcal R_sR_s=((A_n)_s)_n$ with quotient maps. The diagram realization therefore gives $G_{a_X}R_s=\mathcal L_X\mathcal E_{a_X}\mathcal R_sR_s=\mathcal L_X\Omega_X=\omega_{X,R}$, with the same finite projections as the dualizing construction. Steps 3 and 4 equip this value with the specialized adjunction and its finite units and counits.

source.place: Last sentence: structure morphism and coefficient unit

theorem boundedConstructibleIntegral_exceptionalAdjoint {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (aX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aX] [QuasiCompact aX]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] [IsSeparated aX] [IsSeparated aY]
    [HasCompactification aX] [HasCompactification aY]
    [(R(aX)_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).IsLeftAdjoint] [(R(aY)_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).IsLeftAdjoint]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ aY = aX) [QuasiCompact f] [HasCompactification f]
    [(R(f)_![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).IsLeftAdjoint] {L : 𝐃(Y, Λ)}
    (hL : DerivedCategory.boundedConstructibleIntegral I Y L)
    {c : Cone (DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionDiagram Y.smallEtaleTopology I L ⋙
      R(f)^![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])} (hc : Pretriangulated.IsHomotopyLimit c) :
    (DerivedCategory.boundedConstructibleIntegral I X c.pt ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty ((reductionModIdeal Λ X (I ^ n)).obj c.pt ≅
        (R(f)^![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj ((reductionModIdeal Λ Y (I ^ n)).obj L))) ∧
    (∃ e : (R(f)^![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj L ≅ c.pt, ∀ n : ℕ,
      e.hom ≫ c.π.app (op n) = (R(f)^![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
        ((DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionCone Y.smallEtaleTopology I L).π.app (op n))) ∧
    (∀ (ωX : Cone (DerivedCategory.quotPowFunctor (Spec (.of k)).smallEtaleTopology I ⋙
        R(aX)^![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])) (_ : Pretriangulated.IsHomotopyLimit ωX)
      (ωY : Cone (DerivedCategory.quotPowFunctor (Spec (.of k)).smallEtaleTopology I ⋙
        R(aY)^![ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])) (_ : Pretriangulated.IsHomotopyLimit ωY)
      (N : 𝐃(X, Λ)) (φ : (L((f)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])).obj
        (((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Y).obj (op L)).obj ωY.pt) ⟶ N),
      DerivedCategory.derivedComplete X.smallEtaleTopology I N →
        (∀ n : ℕ, IsIso ((reductionModIdeal Λ X (I ^ n)).map φ)) →
          Nonempty (c.pt ≅ ((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).obj (op N)).obj ωX.pt)) ∧
    ∀ dX dY : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (dX : WithBot ℕ∞) →
      topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (dY : WithBot ℕ∞) → ∀ a b : ℤ,
        (∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Y a b
          ((reductionModIdeal Λ Y (I ^ (n + 1))).obj L)) →
        ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X
          (a - 2 * (dX : ℤ)) (b + 2 * (dY : ℤ))
          ((reductionModIdeal Λ X (I ^ (n + 1))).obj c.pt)
